5363.title: Intermittent queued-message send rejection
5363.rootCauseOneLine: Incident cause unconfirmed: the queued-send title covers transport and server errors; a deliberately removed queue row returns HTTP 404 in both clean checks.
5363.proposedFix: Capture the full toast explanation, queued-send HTTP status/body, and queue/timeline state before designing a failing regression; no production fix is justified yet.
5363.caveats: Linux in-process control only; the intermittent Windows/Tailscale failure, upgrade regression, browser action, and any message loss remain unverified. Both checks were performed by the same investigator.
